newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Semiconductor recovery seen in '97.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Semiconductor recovery seen in '97.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Thomas Kurlak repeated his forecast for a quick recovery for the U.S. semiconductor industry in 1997.

-- In an analysis dated Dec 31, Kurlak said, "With no recession predicted for 1997, and the inventory adjustment now over, the recovery back to the 42 percent sales growth peak reached in July 1995 could occur in a similarly smaller proportion of time, perhaps as quickly as 23 to 24 months or by December of 1998."

-- He added, "We are expecting a quick recovery and forecast sales growth of 20 percent for 1997. We continue to see upside earnings surprise potential for the major U.S. semiconductor producers and recommend purchase of selected equities."
-- They include Intel Corp, Micron Technology Inc, Texas Instruments Inc, Avnet Inc, Altera Corp and Xilinx Inc.
